definitions.explanation: The loudness or intensity of sound, especially as controlled on electronic devices.

examples.japanese: {音量|おんりょう}を{上|あ}げる。
{音量|おんりょう}を{下|さ}げてください。
マイクの{音量|おんりょう}を{調整|ちょうせい}する。

notes:
{音量|おんりょう} refers specifically to the volume or loudness of sound.

WORD FORMATION:
{音|おん} (sound) + {量|りょう} (quantity, amount) = sound volume

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {音量|おんりょう}を{上|あ}げる: to turn up the volume
- {音量|おんりょう}を{下|さ}げる: to turn down the volume
- {音量|おんりょう}を{調整|ちょうせい}する: to adjust the volume
- {音量|おんりょう}{調節|ちょうせつ}: volume control
- {最大|さいだい}{音量|おんりょう}: maximum volume

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ボリューム: volume (loanword, commonly used)
- {音|おと}の{大|おお}きさ: loudness (more casual)
